plugins.name: mentor
plugins.description: A plugin-owned planning harness for Claude Code: fail-closed read-only planning (no native plan mode), with research and plan authoring delegated to subagents. The plan deliverable is user-configurable per repo — a bespoke styled-HTML document or a Mermaid-first Markdown document — shaped per domain.

plugins.name: sdlc-mini
plugins.description: Turbo SDLC helpers: a release-notes generator and a tidy commit helper. Manifest and env-config setup have moved to the devflow plugin; init-turbo-manifest and init-turbo-env-config remain as deprecated redirects.

plugins.name: devflow
plugins.description: Generic spec → code → ship development workflow: gated stages, staged in-repo docs, and an optional branded bilingual HTML plan render. Project-agnostic; bundles the org coding-standard skills (Go object storage, NATS JetStream outbox & SMS/email via the org Go messaging library, plus language-agnostic DB migrations) and auto-applies the matching one during a feature. Also owns the turbo-manifest deployment-manifest lifecycle (init / add-app / validate / migrate / explain) with a schema-gated validator.
